title: Collection Synchronization via clear() + extend() (ORM Churn)
pattern: Clearing an entire ORM-managed collection field and then repopulating it with a new set of elements to perform an update.
why_bad: It generates heavy, redundant database churn. Instead of updating changed items, it fires immediate deletes for all existing entries followed by inserts for the entire list, bloating the database transaction log.
detection: An entity method that calls both `.clear()` and `.extend()` (or `.add_all()`) on an ORM collection relationship within the same unit of work.
counterexample: Performing full collection replacement on a non-persisted local collection.
fix: Diff the collections to only perform targeted inserts, updates, or deletes on items that have actually changed.
